description: Reconfiguration of internal layout. Replacement of non-original flooring with parquet on ground floor, and with floating engineered timber flooring on upper floors. Replacement of tiling in bathrooms. Exposure of original cornicing, and installation of matching cornicing in areas where cornicing has been lost. Replacement of non-original wardrobes and joinery. Installation of period appropriate fireplaces. Replacement of all bathrooms and kitchens. Replacement of electrical, plumbing and heating services. Repair and full redecoration throughout.First floor rear infill extension in matching brick with re-insertion of reclaimed facade window. Replacement of loft level side-facing dormer window with door, and installation of metal balustrade to create roof terrace. Insertion of flat rooflight concealed behind existing parapet.
